items.name: Cubing in Corinda Sunday 2024
items.information:
This competition is catered specifically for newcomers but returning competitors are also welcome!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBalZZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25fbe6a68cc38efbc2f183f96af7edc58b241431/WCA%20Newcomer%20Month%20LOGO_A1.jpg)
This competition is a series competition - you may only register and compete for either Saturday or Sunday

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Stevenage Newcomers Sunday 2024
items.information:
This competition is targeted a first-time competitors and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Medals will be awarded to the fastest newcomers.

**PLEASE NOTE**: This is a Series Competition with Stevenage Newcomers Saturday 2024. You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StevenageNewcomersSunday2024#36087-series-competition) tab.

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

[![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
